headings.instruction: Use robust, condensed sans-serif for headings to evoke elite athletic performance. Never use generic 'Inter' for H1-H3. Use text-[clamp(3rem,8vw,5rem)] for Hero.

body.instruction: Clean, geometric body font to balance the heavy headings. Use high contrast for readability.

accent.instruction: Use this neon lime green (Verde-lima) EXCLUSIVELY for key CTAs ('Comprar Caneleiras XOK\'S', 'Adicionar ao Carrinho') and active states. Do not use for large backgrounds.

visual enhancers.surfaces: Use Glassmorphism 2.0 (backdrop-blur-xl with a 1px border-white/10) for the sticky nav and slide-out cart. Use pure black or dark charcoal for deep backgrounds.
visual enhancers.shadows: Minimal external shadows. Use drop-shadows on typography over images to ensure readability. Use sharp 1px solid strokes to define elements.
visual enhancers.textures: Incorporate carbon fiber textures strategically in the 'Proposta de Valor' section.

components.name: Navigation
components.instruction: Sticky top, backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60. Logo left, Cart icon right (triggers Sheet).

components.name: Slide-out Cart
components.instruction: Use Shadcn Sheet component. Dark surface, distinct neon 'Finalizar Compra' button at the bottom.

components.name: Checkout Form
components.instruction: One-page checkout. Minimalist inputs: transparent background, border-b only or sharp 1px border. Focus state must ring neon lime.

components.name: Value Proposition Bento
components.instruction: Use raw HTML+Tailwind for an asymmetrical Bento grid (Grid cols 1 md:cols-3) to highlight the 3 pillars.

grids.bento_marketing: Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-12. Gap Strategy: Wide (gap-8 to gap-12). Never fill 100% of the grid perfectly.
grids.dashboard_admin: Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Gap Strategy: Tight (gap-4 or gap-6). Use for Admin orders list.

layouts.hero: Full-height (min-h-[90vh]) with the stadium background image masked heavily in black/charcoal (bg-black/60) to ensure text legibility. Large heading aligned center or left, vibrant CTA.
layouts.product_showcase: Asymmetrical layout. Left: Sticky product area with clean dark background. Right: Scrolling specifications, price highlighted, and Add to Cart button.
layouts.admin_orders: Dense, functional high-contrast dashboard for managing orders. Cardless table.

motion.entrance: Fade-in and translate-y up on scroll for main sections.
motion.hover: Glowing hover effects on the main CTA button (box-shadow neon glow).
motion.micro: Purposeful micro-interactions on the Add to Cart and sliding cart. Use framer-motion.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text on images has a dark overlay (bg-black/60) to meet APCA contrast ratios.
accessibility.focus: All focus rings must use the accent color (#CCFF00) and have a 2px offset.

3d libraries.decision: Skip heavy 3D rendering to maintain peak performance and conversion rates. Rely on framer-motion for smooth 2D transformations.

image_urls.instruction: Overlay with heavy bg-black/70 to make text pop.
Use as a background pattern for the 'Material Ultra Resistente' bento card.
Use in the feature highlight section to anchor the product to the sport.
Use for the elite athlete testimonial photo.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install the necessary fonts: Google Fonts (Bebas Neue, Manrope).
Do not build HTML-based components for advanced interactions like the Cart, use Shadcn Sheet.
Implement the landing page primarily with pure HTML/Tailwind for customizability, breaking away from boring symmetry.
Ensure the Volt/Lime accent (#CCFF00) is used sparingly, ONLY for actionable elements like 'Adicionar ao Carrinho' to maximize conversion.
Ensure checkout form is contained in one page (One-Page Checkout) with intuitive fields.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing. Avoid generic centered layouts and simplistic gradients. Ensure layered elements with proper z-index. Apply transitions exclusively to active elements avoiding universal `transition: all`. Do not center align the app container text.
